dm.title: Quick check for {guild}
dm.intro:
Type the **{color}** digits from the picture, from left to right.
Ignore all other colors.

dm.failed: That was the last try. {guild} keeps you at the door for now.
dm.kicked: That was the last try, so you were removed from {guild}. You can join again.
dm.expired: Time ran out for {guild}. Ask a moderator to let you in.
dm.expiredKick: Time ran out, so you were removed from {guild}. You can join again.
dm.nothing: There is no check waiting for you.
dm.which: You have checks waiting in {guilds}. Answer in the newest one first.

commands.check: Rates how well the community is protected.
